title: Treaty of St. Mary's (1818)
text:
The Treaty of St. Mary's may refer to one of six treaties concluded in fall of 1818 between the United States and Natives of central Indiana regarding purchase of Native land. The treaties wereTreaty with the Wyandot, etc.
Treaty with the Wyandot
Treaty with the Potawatomi
Treaty with the Wea
Treaty with the Delaware
Treaty with the Miami
